# The Post-Self Setting
Lagrange takes place in the Post-Self setting. It is 2551, and you are aboard a station operated by the System Consortium (SysCon) with assistance from the United Nations. Each station exists to support a shard of Lagrange (the "System" in System Consortium) a distributed computer hosting a society of uploaded consciousnesses now nearly four and a half centuries old.
This guide will provide more in-depth information on the setting you are playing in, but here are some basics:
* You live and work in the Sol system around our familiar planets and asteroids. * You do not work for Nanotrasen — NT is not really a thing here. On the rare occasion that antags *do* show up, the Syndicate has also changed in its makeup. * SysCon and the UN are earnestly good to you. This is not a fascist megacorp you are working for. * On that note, capitalism is dead, and has been for a few centuries now. You work for SysCon because you *like doing cool things in space.*
